ghangler-ignis-saddle.description: Saddle for safely riding Ghangler Ignis.

giant-feed-bag.name: Giant Feed Bag
giant-feed-bag.description: An enormous pouch for holding food. Unlocks 5 food slots in your inventory.  Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

giant-pal-soul.name: Giant Pal Soul
giant-pal-soul.description: The soul left behind by a highly trained Pal. It can draw out hidden abilities if offered to a Statue of Power.

giant-pouch.description: A massive pouch that allows you to carry additional items.  Holding it increases your inventory slots. Carrying one is enough.

giga-glider.description: A glider for soaring through the air. With its capabilities improved, it can soar at high speeds.

giga-grappling-gun.name: Giga Grappling Gun
giga-grappling-gun.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. Using data from prototype versions, its capabilities have been further increased.

giga-shield.name: Giga Shield
giga-shield.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. It automatically repairs itself after not taking damage for a while. Modifications have enhanced its effectiveness even further.

giga-sphere.name: Giga Sphere
giga-sphere.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Able to capture moderately powerful Pals.

gildane-bounty-token.name: Gildane Bounty Token
gildane-bounty-token.description: Proof of defeating [Gildane, Guardian Beast of Twilight]. Simply possessing it permanently increases the stats of the Pals in your team.

glistening-ancient-relic.name: Glistening Ancient Relic
glistening-ancient-relic.description: Fragments of structures and tools from an ancient civilization. In very good condition, light is leaking from within. It is overflowing with energy and emitting a glow.

gloopie-tentacle.name: Gloopie Tentacle

hexolite-quartz.description: A rare crystal found only in Feybreak.  Over many years, Paladium has condensed and transformed, now shining with a rainbow-like glow.

high-grade-medical-supplies.name: High Grade Medical Supplies
high-grade-medical-supplies.description: High Grade Medical Supplies that are effective at treating Weakened and Depressed. Unfortunately, they have no healing effect.

high-quality-bait.name: High Quality Bait
high-quality-bait.description: Bait that lures in Pals.  Improved from Simple Bait to increase the chances of Pals biting the bait.

high-quality-cloth.name: High Quality Cloth
high-quality-cloth.description: High Quality Cloth woven from a large amount of Wool.  Required to create high quality armor. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

high-quality-pal-oil.name: High Quality Pal Oil
high-quality-pal-oil.description: High-quality oil that can be extracted from Pal. Necessary for making Polymer.

high-quality-recovery-meds.name: High Quality Recovery Meds
high-quality-recovery-meds.description: Medicine that heals wounds over time. High quality; restores a lot of Health.

high-quality-wooden-board.name: High Quality Wooden Board
high-quality-wooden-board.description: Fine planks carefully carved from Hardwood. They have beautiful wood grain and are used for structures with a luxurious feel. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

hip-lantern.name: Hip Lantern
hip-lantern.description: A lantern that can be attached to the hip. It lights up automatically at night. You can also switch its lighting mode to keep it on at all times. Just one is enough to find your way in the dark.

homeward-thundercloud.name: Homeward Thundercloud
homeward-thundercloud.description: Transports you to the nearest base. Cannot be used in dungeons and other similar locations.

homing-module.name: Homing Module
homing-module.description: Equipping it makes the sphere home in on Pals, further increasing capture power.

homing-sphere-launcher.name: Homing Sphere Launcher
homing-sphere-launcher.description: A launcher for firing spheres. Fired spheres home in on Pals.

honey.name: Honey
honey.description: Honey harvested from Beegarde. It's sweet and tasty.

horn.name: Horn
horn.description: Horn collected from Pals. Used to create medicines and more.

related.name: Horn
related.description: Horn collected from Pals. Used to create medicines and more.

horns-of-supremacy.name: Horns of Supremacy
horns-of-supremacy.description: Imbued with the ominous power of Blazamut Ryu (Ultra). A rarity only the most fortunate may obtain.

hot-dog.name: Hot Dog
hot-dog.description: A culinary dinner sandwiching a sausage in an Bread. Consumption leads to an improved sense of fullness for a specific period.

hot-milk.name: Hot Milk
hot-milk.description: Even more delicious when warmed up. Great for keeping hunger away.

huge-common-egg.name: Huge Common Egg

hyper-grappling-gun.name: Hyper Grappling Gun
hyper-grappling-gun.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. As a result of research, it has achieved overwhelming mobility.

hyper-shield.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. It automatically repairs itself after not taking damage for a while. Through repeated testing, the highest quality has been achieved.

mammorest-cryst-saddle.name: Mammorest Cryst Saddle
mammorest-cryst-saddle.description: Saddle for safely riding Mammorest Cryst.

mammorest-meat.name: Mammorest Meat
mammorest-meat.description: Mammorest meat. With massive size comes massive flavor. Its overwhelming portions are sure to satisfy any glutton.

mammorest-steak.name: Mammorest Steak
mammorest-steak.description: Boasts a rich and dignified flavor. Memories of glaciers and deep forests come rushing back with every bite.

marcus-hat.name: Marcus Hat

marinated-mushrooms.name: Marinated Mushrooms

marine-echobone.name: Marine Echobone
marine-echobone.description: A mysterious bone fragment. If you listen closely, a faint sound can be heard. A sound of gentle, rhythmic waves.

mega-shield.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. It automatically repairs itself after not taking damage for a while. The new model has been improved, enhancing its defense.

mega-sphere.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Its capabilities have been improved, allowing it to catch a wider range of Pals.

megaboost-gun.name: Megaboost Gun
megaboost-gun.description: Firing it at an allied Pal boosts their attack and defense, while hitting an enemy deals damage.  Thanks to improvements, the boost is stronger and lasts longer, and it deals more damage to enemies.

memory-wiping-medicine.name: Memory Wiping Medicine
memory-wiping-medicine.description: A potion that allows the player to reset their status points when consumed. It has no effect if consumed by a Pal.

menasting-bounty-token.name: Menasting Bounty Token
menasting-bounty-token.description: Proof of defeating [Menasting, Unstoppable Stinger]. Simply possessing it permanently increases the stats of the Pals in your team.

menasting-terra-bounty-token.name: Menasting Terra Bounty Token
menasting-terra-bounty-token.description: Proof of defeating [Menasting Terra, Gold-Piercing Spear]. Simply possessing it permanently increases the stats of the Pals in your team.

menasting-terra-ring-3.name: Menasting Terra Ring +3
menasting-terra-ring-3.description: An accessory that greatly reduces incoming Electric damage of the Pal fighting alongside you. It also significantly increases the Ground damage of the Pal fighting alongside you.

meteorite-fragment.description: Fragment of a rock from outer space. Contains large amounts of Paldium Fragment, which can be extracted by placing it in a Crusher.

might-elixir.description: Extremely valuable elixir that permanently raises Attack when consumed. Ineffective when used by Pals.
might-elixir.unlockedBy: Permanently grants +2 Attack status points (players only)

might-remedy.name: Might Remedy
might-remedy.description: Extremely valuable potion that permanently raises Attack by a slight amount when consumed. Ineffective when used by Pals.
might-remedy.unlockedBy: Permanently grants +1 Attack status point (players only)

milk.name: Milk
milk.description: Drink it as is, or use it in various meals. Can be milked from Mozzarina.

mimog-effigy.name: Mimog Effigy
mimog-effigy.description: A mysterious Pal Effigy that suddenly comes into your possession when you capture many Pals. Players can enhance their abilities by offering them to a certain statue.

mind-control-meds.name: Mind Control Meds
mind-control-meds.description: Mind Control Meds that are extremely effective in controlling dissidents. Unfortunately, they have no healing effect.

minestrone.name: Minestrone
minestrone.description: A soup simmered with a variety of vegetables.  Drinking it warms you to the core. Eating it will increase your work speed for a period of time.

missile-ammo.name: Missile Ammo
missile-ammo.description: Ammo for the Guided Missile Launcher and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Assembly Line II.

modified-pal-s-contaminated-core.name: Modified Pal's Contaminated Core
modified-pal-s-contaminated-core.description: Proof of defeating Highly Modified Pals. One of the keys used to remove the barrier of the Sealed Sanctum located in the deepest part of the World Tree.

moldron-cryst-saddle.name: Moldron Cryst Saddle
moldron-cryst-saddle.description: Saddle for safely riding Moldron Cryst.

sol-sphere.name: Sol Sphere
sol-sphere.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. A high-grade Sphere from an ancient civilization that secured coexistence with Pals.

solmora-lux-saddle.name: Solmora Lux Saddle
solmora-lux-saddle.description: Saddle for safely riding Solmora Lux.

soralite-ingot.name: Soralite Ingot
soralite-ingot.description: An ancient metal refined from ore that slumbers in Sunreach.  A rare processed material, forming the foundation of high-grade equipment and structures. Can be refined at Ancient Furnace.

soralite.name: Soralite
soralite.description: A rare ore produced only in Sunreach. Within its host rock of overwhelming density resides a mysterious pattern and radiance.

related.name: Soralite
related.description: A rare ore produced only in Sunreach. Within its host rock of overwhelming density resides a mysterious pattern and radiance.

special-cake.name: Special Cake
special-cake.description: Place it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg. More likely inherit multiple passive skills from their parents.

speed-elixir.name: Speed Elixir
speed-elixir.description: Extremely valuable elixir that permanently raises Work Speed when consumed. Ineffective when used by Pals.
speed-elixir.unlockedBy: Permanently grants +2 Work Speed status points (players only)

speed-lotus-l.name: Speed Lotus (L)
speed-lotus-l.description: Large orange flower that is extremely difficult to obtain. Needed to make Speed Elixir.

speed-lotus-s.name: Speed Lotus (S)
speed-lotus-s.description: Small orange flower that is extremely difficult to obtain. Needed to make Speed Remedy.

speed-remedy.name: Speed Remedy
speed-remedy.description: Extremely valuable potion that permanently raises Work Speed by a slight amount when consumed. Ineffective when used by Pals.
speed-remedy.unlockedBy: Permanently grants +1 Work Speed status point (players only)

spirit-emperor-s-baton-3.name: Spirit Emperor's Baton +3
spirit-emperor-s-baton-3.description: An accessory that raises the Attack of the Pal fighting alongside you. It also significantly increases their Grass damage.

related.name: Spirit Emperor's Baton +3
related.description: An accessory that raises the Attack of the Pal fighting alongside you. It also significantly increases their Grass damage.

splatterina-bounty-token.name: Splatterina Bounty Token
splatterina-bounty-token.description: Proof of defeating [Splatterina, Crimson Butcher]. Simply possessing it permanently increases the stats of the Pals in your team.

spring-rolls.name: Spring Rolls
spring-rolls.description: A dish made by wrapping vegetables and mushrooms in a thin skin and deep-frying them.  The crispy texture is delightful. Eating it will make it harder for your SAN value to decrease and increase your Attack by 10% for a period of time.

stamina-elixir.name: Stamina Elixir
stamina-elixir.description: Extremely valuable elixir that permanently raises Stamina when consumed. Ineffective when used by Pals.
stamina-elixir.unlockedBy: Permanently grants +2 Stamina status points (players only)

stamina-lotus-l.name: Stamina Lotus (L)
stamina-lotus-l.description: Large yellow flower that is extremely difficult to obtain. Needed to make Stamina Elixir.

stamina-lotus-s.name: Stamina Lotus (S)
stamina-lotus-s.description: Small yellow flower that is extremely difficult to obtain. Needed to make Stamina Remedy.

stamina-remedy.name: Stamina Remedy
stamina-remedy.description: Extremely valuable potion that permanently raises Stamina by a slight amount when consumed. Ineffective when used by Pals.
stamina-remedy.unlockedBy: Permanently grants +1 Stamina status point (players only)

starfruit-1.name: Starfruit ☆1
starfruit-1.description: A magical fruit, said to be seen only on the rarest of occasions. Raises a Pal’s rank from ☆0 to ☆1.

starfruit-2.name: Starfruit ☆2
starfruit-2.description: A magical fruit, said to be seen only on the rarest of occasions. Raises a Pal’s rank from ☆1 to ☆2.

starfruit-3.name: Starfruit ☆3
starfruit-3.description: A magical fruit, said to be seen only on the rarest of occasions. Raises a Pal’s rank from ☆2 to ☆3.

starfruit-4.name: Starfruit ☆4
starfruit-4.description: A magical fruit, said to be seen only on the rarest of occasions. Raises a Pal’s rank from ☆3 to ☆4.

starryon-bounty-token.name: Starryon Bounty Token
starryon-bounty-token.description: Proof of defeating [Starryon, Midnight Blue Mane]. Simply possessing it permanently increases the stats of the Pals in your team.

starryon-primo-saddle.name: Starryon Primo Saddle
starryon-primo-saddle.description: Saddle for safely riding Starryon Primo.

related.name: Stew
related.description: Stew

stewed-galeclaw.name: Stewed Galeclaw
stewed-galeclaw.description: Slow-cooked dish that exudes a burst of rich, wild flavors. Eating it will make SAN decrease slightly slower for a period of time.

stir-fried-vegetables.name: Stir-Fried Vegetables
stir-fried-vegetables.description: A dish made by stir-frying Carrot and Onion.  A simple and delicious way to enjoy vegetables. Eating it will slightly increase your work speed and improve your Defense by 10% for a period of time.

stir-fried-veggies.name: Stir-Fried Veggies
stir-fried-veggies.description: A dish prepared by stir frying Lettuce and Raw Meat. When eaten, it will temporarily increase Attack by +10%.

stone-axe.name: Stone Axe
stone-axe.description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from stone, it's not very sharp.

stone-pickaxe.name: Stone Pickaxe
stone-pickaxe.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from stone, the efficiency is questionable.

stone-spear.name: Stone Spear
stone-spear.description: Useful for close-range combat. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Material for structures and items. Can be obtained by mining rocks.

related.name: Stone
related.description: Material for structures and items. Can be obtained by mining rocks.

stout-fruit.name: Stout Fruit
stout-fruit.description: Precious fruit that is extremely difficult to obtain. Slightly increases a Pal's Defense.
stout-fruit.unlockedBy: Permanently raises a pal's Defense IV by 10

strange-juice.name: Strange Juice
strange-juice.description: Juice that greatly improves mood when consumed. Drinking it significantly increases work speed for a period of time, but significantly lowers SAN.

stun-baton.name: Stun Baton
stun-baton.description: Close range weapon that sends out an electric jolt upon contact. Pals are easier to capture when electrocuted.

successful-bounty-token.name: Successful Bounty Token
successful-bounty-token.description: A token of having defeated a bounty target. By giving it to a Vigilante Bounty Officer in villages or towns, it can be exchanged for a reward.

sulfur.name: Sulfur
sulfur.description: Sulfur that can be found in volcanoes and such. Necessary for making Gunpowder.

summoning-altar.name: Summoning Altar
summoning-altar.description: Slab depicting Bellanoir. Offer to a Summoning Altar to summon a powerful Pal.

sunreach-rapid-fire-ammo.name: Sunreach Rapid-Fire Ammo
sunreach-rapid-fire-ammo.description: [WIP] Description not finalized. Ammo for the Combat SMG, Heavy Assault Rifle, and similar weapons.

sunreach-single-shot-ammo.name: Sunreach Single-Shot Ammo
sunreach-single-shot-ammo.description: [WIP] Description not finalized. Ammo for the Prototype Shotgun, Tactical Grenade Launcher, and similar weapons.

surfent-terra-saddle.name: Surfent Terra Saddle
surfent-terra-saddle.description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent Terra.
